_comment: Configuration for the claude-desktop-mouse skill. Changes take effect immediately; no need to restart the daemon.

hotkeys._comment: Global hotkeys. `toggle` switches mouse takeover on/off; `panic` stops everything immediately and disarms. Restart the daemon after changing these. Run `python guardd.py --scan` to see which combinations are free. Note: ctrl+alt+space is usually taken by the IME on Chinese Windows.

approval._comment: `balanced` profile. tier_refuse: refused outright, handed to the user. tier_confirm: Claude must obtain explicit user consent first.
approval._wordlist_comment: The keyword lists are bilingual (Chinese + English) because UI text is localized. If you use a browser in another language, ADD THAT LANGUAGE'S TERMS — the gate only matches what is in these lists.
approval._require_user_code_note: When enabled, any action hitting tier_confirm requires a one-time code that is shown ONLY in a system dialog — the user reads it and tells Claude. This means a prompt-injected model cannot complete a dangerous action on its own. The cost is a popup per dangerous action.

whitelist._comment: Only these processes and window classes may be operated. Enforced in code, not by asking the model nicely.

safety._comment: `enforce_user_idle` is off by default because the OS 'last input time' includes the script's own synthetic input — turning it on makes any multi-step automation stall at step two. The Ctrl+Alt+F9 arm switch is the real control.
safety._failsafe_corner_note: Slam the cursor into the top-left corner and hold for 0.35 s to abort. The only reason to turn this off is if you genuinely need to click the pixel at (0,0).

speed._comment: The speed/reliability tradeoff. `mouse_speed` is a multiplier; 1.0 = human speed. At 10x the cursor effectively teleports — no human moves 1800 px in 80 ms, so this setting is purely buying speed with realism. `typing_wpm` is character-by-character typing speed; 200 is near the human limit (world record ≈ 212). With `typing_mode: auto`, texts longer than `paste_threshold` characters are pasted via the clipboard — over 100x faster, and humans do paste long text.
speed._advice: For sites with strict bot mitigation, use mouse_speed 1–3 and typing_mode "type". The current fast profile is fine for everyday browsing.

logging._comment: The audit log records actions only. It never records typed text, clipboard contents, or screenshot data.
